title: WHAT IF LIGHT KEPT GETTING SLOWER?

segments.line: Light is the fastest thing in the universe.
Three hundred thousand kilometers every second. Seven and a half times around the Earth in one blink. That's real.
Then, on a Monday morning at seven o'clock, it
hour after that, on the hour, it halves again. Hour one, half as fast. Hour two, a quarter. Hour ten, a thousand times slower.
By tomorrow, you could beat it in a race. The rules.
Only light slows down, and everything that travels like light. Radio. Wi- Fi. Phone signals. GPS.
Your body, electricity and everything made of atoms still work fine.
Otherwise this would be a very short video. And one
more rule, the oldest one in physics.
Everything you see has already happened. Light only ever shows you the past.
Today, it's a billionth of a second ago. You'd never notice.
Because it's about to get very, very noticeable.
